hypotheses.justification: Only the column index ι needs to be finite for Matrix.mulVec. Without this hypothesis, apply function extensionality at i : ι'; unfolding Matrix.mulVec_apply_eq_sum and Basis.toMatrix_apply gives exactly b'.sum_repr_mul_repr b m i (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Basis/Defs.lean). This lemma requires only [Fintype ι], already available, and handles empty indices and trivial semirings as well.
